correctness.rationale: For smooth marked a,b over Fbar_7, the hyperelliptic Hasse/Cartier matrix (c_{7i-j}) from f^3 has form [[c6,0,c4],[0,c12,0],[c4,0,c6]] and is diagonalized by a constant F7-rational invertible matrix into H-, H0, H+. This also diagonalizes the Frobenius-semilinear products; nonzero eigenfunctions stay nonzero so f7 is the number of nonzero H factors and a-number=3-f7. The six intersections H0 with Hasse lines factor completely over F7, and pairs of opposite-family lines have F7 intersections or are parallel; checking all 20 smooth marked F7 pairs gives rank counts 2,12,6,0 and the exact 12 rank-one list. Thus the geometric rank≤1 assertion is exhaustive, not merely finite enumeration.
